title: Argument segments in a call
statement: Let a call specification have an ordered argument-register list, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $W$ assign a Boolean word to each register. For any index $a$ less than the length of the argument list, segment $a+1$ in the call's segment list is the pair consisting of the word assigned by $W$ to argument register $a$, and a flag that is true exactly when $a+1$ is less than the length of the argument list.
hypotheses_covered: A call specification with an ordered argument-register list
A word assignment $W$ on the registers
An index $a$ with $a<\text{length of the argument list}$
